poster_title: Automated Evaluation of Personalized Text Generation using Large Language Models
authors: Yaqing Wang, Jiepu Jiang, Mingyang Zhang, Cheng Li, Yi Liang, Qiaozhu Mei, Michael Bendersky

panels.headline: Personalized text generation aims to tailor output to individual user contexts and preferences, providing enhanced relevance and user experience.
content: Traditional metrics like BLEU and ROUGE are inadequate for evaluating personalized text generation.
Human judgments are costly and impractical in personalized settings.
AuPEL framework leverages the comprehension ability of large language models (LLMs) to evaluate personalized text generation.
AuPEL measures personalization, quality, and relevance through pairwise comparisons.
LLMs are instructed using carefully curated prompts to perform these evaluations.

panels.headline: Lack of robust and automated evaluation methods for personalized text generation.
content: Infeasibility of producing personalized references for every user.
Need to capture nuances between personalization, quality, and relevance without relying on human-generated ground truths.
AuPEL addresses these challenges by using LLMs for evaluation.
AuPEL can handle various text generators, user profiles, and generation contexts.
AuPEL shows higher agreement with user-generated ground truths than human raters and traditional metrics.

panels.headline: Controlled experiments comparing the accuracy, consistency, and sensitivity of AuPEL with human annotators and traditional metrics.
content: Experiments involving different text generators, varying in model size, user profiles, and generation context.
AuPEL achieves near-perfect consistency and sensitivity even with a small number of test cases.
LLM evaluators outperform human annotators in distinguishing personalized user-generated text from AI-generated text.
panels.figure_caption: Agreement between evaluators and assumed truth (GOLD > XXL > XL) at test case level; error bars represent 95% confidence intervals. AuPEL is more accurate than human raters and traditional NLG metrics.

panels.headline: AuPEL is a significant step forward in the automated evaluation of personalized text generation.
content: AuPEL can accurately and consistently evaluate personalization, quality, and relevance without human annotations.
The datasets used in the studies will be released for research purposes.
AuPEL outperforms human raters and traditional metrics in evaluating personalized text generation.
Further validation with diverse user groups is needed.
AuPEL opens new avenues for the development and evaluation of personalized text generation systems.
